context: Two teens chat about a karaoke night plan after school
purpose: Teach: カラオケ/シャワー/親父/外出/ねこ/飲ま/眠っ/つまらない

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ、今夜カラオケ行かない？放課後ずっと話してたやつ。
lines.en: Hey, wanna hit karaoke tonight? The thing we kept talking about after school.
lines.style: Casual teen invitation with rising excitement and familiar tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 行きたいけど、うちの親父が最近うるさくてさ、外出の時間にめっちゃ厳しいんだよ。
lines.en: I wanna go, but my old man's been a pain lately, super strict about when I can go out.
lines.style: Whiny teen complaint, slightly slangy, dragging out for sympathy.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: えー、つまらない。じゃあ早めに集合してさ、九時前には帰せばよくない？
lines.en: Aww, lame. Then let's meet up early, get you home before nine, yeah?
lines.style: Playful pushback, bargaining tone with upward inflection at end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うーん、まあ親父も金曜は早く飲まされて、いつも十時には眠ってるからバレないかも。
lines.en: Hmm, well Dad usually gets drinks forced on him Fridays and is asleep by ten, so maybe he won't notice.
lines.style: Conspiratorial mumble, working it out aloud, slightly mischievous.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 完璧じゃん！じゃあ私も家でシャワーだけ浴びて、すぐ駅前で合流しよう。
lines.en: Perfect! Then I'll just grab a quick shower at home and meet you right at the station.
lines.style: Bright, plan-locking enthusiasm with a clap-worthy delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 了解。あ、でも妹がうちのねこの世話頼んできたら、ちょっと遅れるかも。
lines.en: Got it. Oh, but if my little sis dumps cat duty on me, I might be a bit late.
lines.style: Casual confirmation pivoting to a sheepish disclaimer.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねこ優先でいいよ〜。歌うリスト考えながら待ってる！
lines.en: Cat comes first, no worries~. I'll be waiting and brainstorming our song list!
lines.style: Warm, teasing reassurance with a singsong final note.
